title: Overview
description: Recently updated projects, each with the next step its shots call for.
noProjectsDescription: Create a project on the Projects page, then import a script to start.

importScript.title: Import a script
importScript.detail: This project has no shots yet. Import a script to break it into scenes and shots.

resolveBlocked.detail: A missing reference, a missing upstream frame or a lint blocker stops generation. Open the first blocked shot to see why.

checkFailed.detail: The last generation of these shots failed. The queue shows each task's error.

pickTakes.detail: No take is selected and nothing is generating. Generate a take, or review existing takes and select one for the timeline.

waitGeneration.detail: Tasks are queued or running. Follow them in the queue.

assemble.title: Assemble and export
assemble.detail: Every shot has a selected take. Assemble the timeline and export an MP4.

connectionHealth.title: Connection Health
connectionHealth.description: AI providers and account pools ready for generation.
